title: Demi Weakly Dunford-Pettis on Banach Spaces
summary: In this paper, our main goal is to define the class of weakly Demi Dunford-Pettis applications. We also study their relationship with the classes of weakly Dunford-Pettis and Demi Dunford-Pettis operators, including a condition where these operators coincide with Demi Dunford-Pettis and Demicompacts. In the last section, we study some of the behavior of this class in the Banach Lattice environment.
